summary: Tested Customer Branding Profile endpoints, new Document Library categories via /documents/from-ai, and the three refreshed Marketing AI tool generate calls. Frontend UI smoke: 5-tab customer drawer with Branding tab, Marketing category shows 5 tools (social_job_post removed), merged Completed Order Post Creator exposes Post Mode selector. Backend: 16/16 pytest passing. Frontend: 5/5 smoke checks passing.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/ai.py is 3632 lines — consider splitting per-tool groups (marketing/branding/design/business) into submodules; exceeds the 700-line guideline.
Branding append endpoint caps logos to BRANDING_LOGO_CAP=3 via FIFO slicing; if a client sends a logos list >3 on initial PUT, the PUT does slice (line 339) — good. Append path also slices correctly.

DocumentCategory enum still ships legacy `get_categories` list handler (/categories/list) that does NOT include the new marketing/branding categories — frontend filters that rely on this endpoint will not show the 8 new categories. Not blocking current tests but worth mirroring in that list.
completed_job_post prompt uses {include_hashtags} as string-formatted boolean — behaves but consider passing pre-formatted 'Yes/No' for clarity.
seed_data_creation: Created & torn down one TEST_BrandingCustomer per test run; 8 TEST_ AI documents (one per new category) are created and deleted in the same test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest lives at /app/backend/tests/test_branding_and_marketing_tools.py. It auto-reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env if env var missing. /api/ai/generate request schema uses fields 'tool' and 'input_data' (NOT tool_id/inputs). Admin login returns 'access_token'. Branding endpoints: GET/PUT/POST append all return 200 and work as specced. Frontend Branding tab data-testid='customer-branding-tab-trigger' exists, 5 tabs in customer drawer. AI Tools Marketing filter shows 5 tools; the merged Completed Order Post Creator exposes a 'Post Mode' select (with_image/text_only).
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Initial pytest run failed for 3 AI tests because the test used wrong payload keys (tool_id/inputs); corrected to (tool/input_data) per AIGenerateRequest model in routes/ai.py lines 38-40, all 16 tests now pass.
